title: Four Poses of Armored Warrior
description: Four identical side-by-side photographs of a male warrior figurine in a dynamic combat stance, holding a dagger in his right hand with his left fist raised. The figure wears detailed bronze and gold fantasy armor with a red cape, leather straps, and boots against a dark gradient background.
prompt: Highly detailed painted miniature of a fantasy rogue warrior in dynamic combat pose, holding a dagger forward with one fist raised, wearing ornate bronze and gold armor with leather straps, red cape, and boots, muscular build, intense expression, standing on a dark studio background, photographed from a slight low angle, four identical copies arranged horizontally
